column1: # Overrides of the Ecobalyse entries used for OFF ingredients, used by extract_ecobalyse_ingredient_properties.pl
# The ecobalyse_ properties are removed from the ingredients taxonomy and regenerated by
# update_ecobalyse_ingredients_matches.sh: manual fixes must be made here, not in the taxonomy.
#   default: use this entry as the default entry of the OFF ingredient (instead of the automatically selected one)
#   exclude: never use this entry for the OFF ingredient
#   add: add this entry (e.g. from another baseIngredient) as a variant, according to its origin and label
# Overrides also apply to proxy targets (base_ingredients_proxies_for_off_ingredients.tsv).
# Overridden entries are used even if they are hidden (visible=false) in Ecobalyse.
# "Huile de tournesol par défaut (2025)" costs about 7460 points per kg in the food2 API (2026-11),
# 18 to 30 times more than the FR (417) and UE (250) sunflower oils and the default rapeseed oil (423)
# 2026-11-24: the UE sunflower oil ea419fa9 was removed from Ecobalyse (hidden entries are no longer exported): use the refined FR one
# The butter baseIngredient has 3 "Origine Inconnue" entries (light 39-41%, reduced 60-62%, standard 82% fat):
